35168-danira.description: A book by E. Werner.. "I should think so," answered George. "When a man has seen nothing but mountains all his life, it's no small matter to toss about on this confounded glittering blue sea, as we have done for three days and nights. 67229-an-art-shop-in-greenwich-village.creator: Ray Cummings
67229-an-art-shop-in-greenwich-village.description: A book by Ray Cummings. “The _señor_ has lived in Granada! My birthplace, _señor_—yet for fifteen years have I been here in your New York. Fifteen years, selling here the treasures of _España_. You have lived in Granada—ah, then, _señor_, the Alhambra you have seen?”

arxiv-1803-04030.title: Modeling Singing F0 With Neural Network Driven Transition-Sustain Models
arxiv-1803-04030.description: Abstract This study focuses on generating fundamental frequency (F0) curves of singing voice from musical scores stored in a midi-like notation. Current statistical parametric approaches to singing F0 modeling meet difficulties in reproducing vibratos and the temporal details at note boundaries due to the oversmoothing tendency of statistical models.

arxiv-2204-00009.title: On products of symmetries in von Neumann algebras
arxiv-2204-00009.creator: B V Rajarama Bhat, Soumyashant Nayak, P Shankar
arxiv-2204-00009.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by B V Rajarama Bhat, Soumyashant Nayak, P Shankar. Let ℛ \mathscr{R} be a type I ​ I 1 II_{1} von Neumann algebra. We show that every unitary in ℛ \mathscr{R} may be decomposed as the product of six symmetries (that is, self-adjoint unitaries) in ℛ \mathscr{R} , and every unitary in ℛ \mathscr{R} with finite spectrum may be decomposed as the product of four symmetries in ℛ \mathscr{R} .

arxiv-2408-06045.title: DC-DC Converters Optimization in Case of Large Variation in the Load
arxiv-2408-06045.creator: Alexander Domyshev \aref sei,poly, Elena Chistyakova \aref poly,idstu, Aliona Dreglea \aref poly,hit, Denis Sidorov \aref sei, Fang Liu \aref csu
arxiv-2408-06045.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alexander Domyshev \aref sei,poly, Elena Chistyakova \aref poly,idstu, Aliona Dreglea \aref poly,hit, Denis Sidorov \aref sei, Fang Liu \aref csu. The method for controlling a DC-DC converter is proposed to ensures the high quality control at large fluctuations in load currents by using differential gain control coefficients and second derivative control. Various implementations of balancing the currents of a multiphase DC-DC converter are discussed, with a focus on achieving accurate current regulation without introducing additional delay in the control system.

arxiv-2408-15935.title: ORIGIN AND FULL CHARACTERIZATION OF THE SECONDARY (ASSEMBLY) HALO BIAS
arxiv-2408-15935.creator: Eduard Salvador-Solé, Alberto Manrique, and Eduard Agulló
arxiv-2408-15935.description: Abstract The clustering of dark matter halos depends not only on their mass, the so-called primary bias, but also on their internal properties, the so-called secondary bias. While the former effect is well-understood within the Press-Schechter (PS) and excursion set (ES) models of structure formation, the latter is not.

arxiv-2505-23765.title: From Chat Logs to Collective Insights: Aggregative Question Answering
arxiv-2505-23765.creator: Wentao Zhang, Woojeong Kim, Yuntian Deng
arxiv-2505-23765.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Wentao Zhang, Woojeong Kim, Yuntian Deng. Conversational agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are rapidly becoming integral to our daily interactions, generating unprecedented amounts of conversational data. Such datasets offer a powerful lens into societal interests, trending topics, and collective concerns. Yet, existing approaches typically treat these interactions as independent and miss critical insights that could emerge from aggregating and reasoning across large-scale conversation logs.

arxiv-2506-13185.title: Quantum Recurrent Embedding Neural Network
arxiv-2506-13185.creator: Mingrui Jing, Erdong Huang, Xiao Shi, Shengyu Zhang, Xin Wang
arxiv-2506-13185.description: Abstract Quantum neural networks have emerged as promising quantum machine learning models, leveraging the properties of quantum systems and classical optimization to solve complex problems in physics and beyond. However, previous studies have demonstrated inevitable trainability issues that severely limit their capabilities in the large-scale regime.

pmc-10514360.title: Glioblastoma cellular MAP4K1 facilitates tumor growth and disrupts T effector cell infiltration
pmc-10514360.creator: Jin-Min Sun, Hong-Ye Fan, Yan Zhu, Ting-Ting Pan, Yong-Ping Wu, Dao-Yong Zhang, Xiao-Yu Hou
pmc-10514360.description: MAP4K1 acts as a cancer cell-intrinsic driver of tumorigenesis and immune evasion in human gliomas, specifically glioblastoma multiforme, by modulating cytokine–chemokine signaling networks. Introduction Gliomas are the most prevalent type of primary brain tumors in adults, and remain among the most difficult cancers to treat (Lapointe et al, 2018).

pmc-10638639.title: Commercial Payments for COVID-19–Associated Inpatient Stays in 2020
pmc-10638639.creator: Rose Kerber, Erin L. Duffy, Christopher Whaley
pmc-10638639.description: This cross-sectional study reports the allowed reimbursement amounts for inpatient COVID-19 care for different types of hospitals. Introduction At the COVID-19 pandemic onset in the US in March 2020, the overall volume of hospital inpatient admissions decreased despite the influx of COVID-19–associated admissions.1 Decreases in non–COVID-19 care contributed to reductions in hospital finances and subsequent federal financial assistance to hospitals.

pmc-11292003.title: Development of a nomogram to predict 30-day mortality in patients with post-infarction ventricular septal rupture
pmc-11292003.creator: Zheng Zhang, Yahui Liu, Qianqian Cheng, Jing Zhang, Chuanyu Gao
pmc-11292003.description: Ventricular septal rupture (VSR) is a mechanical complication of acute myocardial infarction (AMI), and its mortality has not decreased significantly in recent decades. However, no clinical model has been developed to predict short-term mortality in patients with post-infarction VSR (PIVSR).

pmc-11390349.title: Editorial: Infectious diseases and cancer: convergence and divergence between bacteria, viruses and helminths
pmc-11390349.creator: Ana Elena Escorcia-Saucedo, Alberto N. Peón, Aldo Christiaan Jardínez-Vera, Luis I. Terrazas, José L. Medina-Franco
pmc-11390349.description: several types of cancer (1–6), as well as some other parasite types like the bacteria Helicobacter pylori (7–9), or parasitic worms like Schistosoma spp., Clonorchis sinensis and Opistorchis viverrini. Or even the fungi Chlamydia trachomatis (10), both as an independent risk factor and as a risk enhancer for the HPV infections.

pmc-11554718.title: A combined debridement, antibiotics, and implant retention (DAIR) procedure with flap coverage for acute soft tissue defects following total knee arthroplasty: a retrospective study
pmc-11554718.creator: Laia Boadas-Gironès, Marta Sabater-Martos, Marc Ferrer-Banus, Àlex Soriano-Viladomiu, Juan Carlos Martínez-Pastor
pmc-11554718.description: Acute soft tissue defects, such as persistent drainage, wound dehiscence, or necrosis, following total knee arthroplasty (TKA) can lead to the devastating complication of deep infection. Typically, when a medium-sized defect is present, a gastrocnemius flap is widely employed for soft tissue reconstruction due to its low morbidity and favourable functional outcomes.

pmc-12623084.title: Comorbidity of Type 1 Diabetes and ADHD: A Longitudinal Cohort Study in Males and Females From the Norwegian Childhood Diabetes Registry
pmc-12623084.creator: Kristin Andersen Bakke, Cathrine Brunborg, Egil Midtlyng, Sissel Berge Helverschou, Torild Skrivarhaug
pmc-12623084.description: AimsThis study of interactions between attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and type 1 diabetes has two aims. First, compare the prevalence of prescribed ADHD medications in individuals with type 1 diabetes to the general paediatric population in Norway. Second, study trajectories in mean glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) in individuals with comorbid ADHD in comparison to individuals with type 1 diabetes only.

pmc-12808113.title: Protective immunity induced by Tp0136 epitope vaccines with mRNA LNP or protein delivery
pmc-12808113.creator: Yinbo Jiang, Nanxuan Huang, Lixia Huang, Xinyuan Li, Xiangcai Zhang, Gang Zheng, Tayier Tuerhong, Han Liu, Jiaxi Lai, Chunmei Liang, Xiaohui Zhang, Liuyuan Wang, Rongyi Chen, Cailing Ao, Bin Yang, Wujian Ke
pmc-12808113.description: Syphilis, caused by Treponema pallidum, remains a major global health burden. Given the key role of T cell–mediated immunity in T. pallidum clearance, this study evaluates a Tp0136-derived T-cell epitope (Tp0136T1) delivered via two platforms: lipid nanoparticle–encapsulated nucleoside-modified mRNA (LNP-mRNA) and Pyrococcus furiosus thioredoxin (PfTrx).

pmc-13007647.title: The role of endoscope-assisted septectomy and membranectomy for complex chronic subdural hematomas: safety, efficacy, technical feasibility. Patient series
pmc-13007647.creator: Mehdi Khaleghi, Adnan Hussain Shahid, Osama Elkadi, Sudhir Suggala, Garrett Dyes, Asa Record Barnett, Danner Butler, Ursula Noelle Hummel, Jai Deep Thakur
pmc-13007647.description: BACKGROUNDBurr hole craniostomy and conventional craniotomy are respectively associated with high recurrence rates and morbidities in the evacuation of septated chronic subdural hematomas (CSDHs). The safety and efficacy of endoscope-assisted septectomy and membranectomy (ESM) via a mini-craniotomy are investigated in this subset of patients.OBSERVATIONSThirteen patients with a mean age of 75 ± 11.

pmc-13068244.title: Effect of impregnation with polyethylene glycols (PEGs) of different end groups on gas separation performance of cross-linked polyethylene oxide (PEO) membranes
pmc-13068244.creator: Shanshan Ji, Teng Wang, Lu Guan, Chengyang Zhao, Shuai Quan, Xuewei Dong, Xianzhi Zhang, Fandi Meng, Zhicheng Tian
pmc-13068244.description: Polymer membranes offer an extremely attractive solution for achieving sustainable carbon dioxide capture and have the potential for large-scale application. The authors prepared almost amorphous polyethylene oxide separation membranes through cross-linking methods, with a CO2/H2 separation coefficient of 7.9. However, there is still the drawback of low CO2 permeability.

pmc-13107529.title: Depth drives microbial assembly while localized tourism selectively enriches bacterial indicator taxa in Lake Fuxian, China
pmc-13107529.creator: Jing Chen, Yuwen Xu, Feng Qin, Da-zhong Yan, Hong-Jun Chao, Jing Wu, Yufei Hu
pmc-13107529.description: IntroductionMicrobial communities play crucial roles in maintaining lake ecosystem stability. In this study, high throughput 16S rRNA gene sequencing combined with diversity and multivariate statistical analyses was used to investigate how anthropogenic activities, particularly tourism, influence the vertical distribution and composition of bacterial and archaeal communities in Lake Fuxian, a deep oligotrophic freshwater lake in southwestern China.

pmc-13396587.title: Tonotopic specialization of MYO7A isoforms in auditory hair cells
pmc-13396587.creator: Sihan Li, Jinho Park, Tobey M Phan, Giusy A Caprara, Natchanon Sittipongpittaya, Gloria M Sheynkman, Anthony W Peng, Edward H Egelman, Jonathan E Bird, Jung-Bum Shin
pmc-13396587.description: Mutations in Myo7a cause Usher syndrome type 1B and non-syndromic deafness, but the precise function of MYO7A in sensory hair cells remains unclear. Using long-read sequencing, we identify and characterize a novel isoform, MYO7A-N, expressed in auditory hair cells alongside the canonical MYO7A-C.

pmc-13462585.title: FAM111B may promote the progression of lung squamous cell carcinoma through PI3K signaling pathway
pmc-13462585.creator: Yajuan Chen, Shiwei Chai, Huimin Wang, Yunyi Chen, Yanting Bi, Yifei Ma, Ruotian Li, Ruiyi Liu, Zaoxiu Hu, Shaoxiang Wan
pmc-13462585.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) is a subtype of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Compared to lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), LUSC is characterized by a greater propensity for recurrence and metastasis, poorer prognosis, and shorter survival. Therefore, further research into the pathogenesis of LUSC and the identification of new therapeutic targets are essential to advance clinical treatment options for this aggressive cancer. FAM111B, a serine protease and cancer-associated nuclear protein, has been implicated in various cancers.

uslaw-usc-t27-s216.title: 27 U.S.C. § 216 — Preemption
uslaw-usc-t27-s216.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t27-s216.description: United States Code, Title 27 (Intoxicating Liquors); Chapter 8 (Federal Alcohol Administration Act); Subchapter II (Alcoholic Beverage Labeling). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No statement relating to alcoholic beverages and health, other than the statement required by section 215 of this title, shall be required under State law to be placed on any container of an alcoholic beverage, or on any box.
